comments: cancellation/past-due/payment-reminder notices should not be purged by the 365-day
retention bracket on that rule; file them here instead. Priority 90 (< 100) so this
wins before the general NYT rule's delete bracket for these specific subjects.
Non-billing NYT mail over 365 days old is unaffected and still purges as before.
2026-08-22: added ordercs@ (order/customer-service) senders as a second, unconditional
branch -- these are order confirmations/receipts, not newsletter content, and were
getting purged by the general rule's 365-day bracket like any other NYT mail.
No age gate: order/billing correspondence is filed here regardless of age.
